description: This file defines the interface MutatorClientInterface for mutating and managing items within the Standard Notes application, including operations like insert, change, delete, protect, unprotect, and sync-related functions.

methods.name: insertItem
methods.description: Inserts the input item by its payload properties, and marks the item as dirty. No automatic sync is performed.

methods.name: changeAndSaveItem
methods.description: Mutates a pre-existing item, marks it as dirty, and syncs it.

methods.name: changeAndSaveItems
methods.description: Mutates multiple items, marks them as dirty, and syncs.

methods.name: changeItem
methods.description: Mutates a pre-existing item without syncing.

methods.name: changeItems
methods.description: Mutates multiple items without syncing.

methods.name: runTransactionalMutations
methods.description: Runs multiple mutations transactionally, then propagates changes.

methods.name: runTransactionalMutation
methods.description: Runs a single transactional mutation.

methods.name: protectItems
methods.description: Protects a list of items.

methods.name: unprotectItems
methods.description: Unprotects a list of items with a challenge reason.

methods.name: protectNote
methods.description: Protects a note.

methods.name: unprotectNote
methods.description: Unprotects a note.

methods.name: protectNotes
methods.description: Protects multiple notes.

methods.name: unprotectNotes
methods.description: Unprotects multiple notes.

methods.name: protectFile
methods.description: Protects a file.

methods.name: unprotectFile
methods.description: Unprotects a file.

methods.name: mergeItem
methods.description: Emits item values onto global state.

methods.name: createTemplateItem
methods.description: Creates an unmanaged item template.

methods.name: setItemNeedsSync
methods.description: Marks an item as needing sync, optionally as user-modified.

methods.name: setItemsNeedsSync
methods.description: Marks multiple items as needing sync.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item.

methods.name: deleteItems
methods.description: Deletes multiple items.

methods.name: emptyTrash
methods.description: Empties the trash.

methods.name: duplicateItem
methods.description: Duplicates an item with optional additional content.

methods.name: migrateTagsToFolders
methods.description: Migrates tags with '.' to schema-based hierarchy.

methods.name: setTagParent
methods.description: Establishes a parent-child relationship between tags.

methods.name: unsetTagParent
methods.description: Removes the parent from a tag.

methods.name: findOrCreateTag
methods.description: Finds or creates a tag.

methods.name: createTagOrSmartView
methods.description: Creates a tag or smart view without syncing.

methods.name: toggleComponent
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a component and syncs.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a theme and syncs.

methods.name: importData
methods.description: Imports data, returning affected items and error count or error.
